bridgeEvents.description: desktop → Gateway: download progress; files land in quarantine.
bridgeEvents.name: bridge.download

bridgeEvents.description: desktop → Gateway: a tab was closed.

bridgeMethods.description: Gateway → desktop: attaches a CDP debugger session to a tab.
bridgeMethods.name: bridge.attach

bridgeMethods.description: Gateway → desktop: forwards one CDP command to an attached tab. Origin policy is enforced by the Gateway's BrowserDriver before sending.
bridgeMethods.name: bridge.cdp.send

bridgeMethods.description: Gateway → desktop: detaches the CDP session.
bridgeMethods.name: bridge.detach

bridgeMethods.description: desktop → Gateway, first frame: authenticates with the per-launch handshake secret (the socket is 0600 as well).

events.description: A new approval request is pending.
events.name: approval.created

events.description: A structured block (plan, checklist, approval, question, artifact, receipt, …) was added to a message.

events.description: Streamed text delta of an agent message.
events.name: chat.delta

events.description: A message was committed (user, agent, system or tool).

methods.description: Approves or denies with the single-use answer token delivered to this surface; deviceOnly and requiresAuthentication kinds are enforced by the Gateway. Not idempotency-keyed: the token is single-use.
methods.name: approvals.answer

methods.description: Returns one approval request.
methods.name: approvals.get

methods.description: Lists approval requests (default: pending), newest first.
methods.name: approvals.list

methods.description: Creates an automation (enabled by default). Side-effecting.
methods.name: automations.create

methods.description: Deletes an automation.
methods.name: automations.delete

methods.description: Lists automations with their next and last run.
methods.name: automations.list

methods.description: Runs an automation now, outside its schedule. Side-effecting: a duplicate would run it twice.
methods.name: automations.run

methods.description: Updates the given fields of an automation.
methods.name: automations.update

methods.description: Closes a tab.
methods.name: browser.close

methods.description: Opens a user tab in the agent browser (http and https only).
methods.name: browser.open

methods.description: Returns the accessibility snapshot of a tab. The content is untrusted page data.
methods.name: browser.snapshot

methods.description: Lists agent browser tabs.
methods.name: browser.tabs

methods.description: Returns one channel.
methods.name: channels.get

methods.description: Lists configured channels.
methods.name: channels.list

methods.description: Cancels the active run (or the given run) in a thread.
methods.name: chat.cancel

methods.description: Exports a transcript as Markdown or JSON.
methods.name: chat.export

methods.description: Queues a message to run after the current turn settles. Side-effecting.
methods.name: chat.followUp

methods.description: Pages the transcript backwards from the newest message.
methods.name: chat.history

methods.description: Lists the thread's queued follow-ups in the order they will run.
methods.name: chat.queue.list

methods.description: Removes a queued follow-up before it starts; false when it already started or is unknown.
methods.name: chat.queue.remove

methods.description: Sends a user message. If the agent is mid-turn the message is queued by mode (default followUp). Side-effecting: requires idempotencyKey; duplicates return the original result.
methods.name: chat.send

methods.description: Interrupts the current tool loop with new guidance. Side-effecting.
methods.name: chat.steer

methods.description: First frame on every connection. Negotiates the protocol version and returns a 60 s challenge nonce.
methods.name: connect

methods.description: Proves possession of the device key by signing connectSigningPayload(...). Returns paired (with owner-chosen scopes), pending (a pairing request awaiting approval) or denied.
methods.name: connect.verify

methods.description: Returns one connector.
methods.name: connectors.get

methods.description: Lists configured connectors.
methods.name: connectors.list

methods.description: Approves a pending pairing request with owner-chosen scopes.
methods.name: devices.approve

methods.description: Denies a pending pairing request.
methods.name: devices.deny

methods.description: Lists paired devices.
methods.name: devices.list

methods.description: Lists pairing requests (default: pending).
methods.name: devices.pairing.list

methods.description: Revokes a device's token and node authority permanently and closes its connections.
methods.name: devices.revoke

methods.description: Replaces this connection's event filters (no filters → every event the device's scopes allow). Returns the current stateVersion.
methods.name: events.subscribe

methods.description: Lists standing grants with use counts and expiry.
methods.name: grants.list

methods.description: Revokes a grant; changing standing permissions is an admin action.
methods.name: grants.revoke

methods.description: Deletes a Library item and its file.
methods.name: library.delete

methods.description: Returns one Library item's metadata (content is fetched over HTTP).
methods.name: library.get

methods.description: Lists Library items, newest first.
methods.name: library.list

methods.description: Reads a workspace memory file, optionally a line range.
methods.name: memory.read

methods.description: Hybrid search (FTS5 + vectors) over memory chunks.
methods.name: memory.search

methods.description: Writes a workspace memory file (default replace). Protected files may require an approval. Side-effecting.
methods.name: memory.write

methods.description: Node → Gateway: streamed progress for an invocation.
methods.name: node.event

methods.description: Gateway → node: run one capability. The node answers accepted, then streams node.event and ends with node.result.
methods.name: node.invoke

methods.description: Node → Gateway: the final outcome of an invocation, with a receipt for side effects.
methods.name: node.result

methods.description: Returns a node's declared capabilities.
methods.name: nodes.capabilities

methods.description: Invokes a node capability through the Permission Broker (may fail with approval_required) and returns its final result. Side-effecting.
methods.name: nodes.invoke

methods.description: Lists paired nodes and their status.
methods.name: nodes.list

methods.description: Lists in-app inbox notifications, newest first.
methods.name: notifications.list

methods.description: Marks notifications read.
methods.name: notifications.markRead

methods.description: Resolves a notification, optionally by one of its actions. Approval actions still go through approvals.answer.
methods.name: notifications.resolve

methods.description: Lists sandboxes.
methods.name: sandbox.list

methods.description: Reports the container backend and, with sandboxId, one sandbox's state.
methods.name: sandbox.status

methods.description: Unified search across the given scopes (default all).
methods.name: search.query

methods.description: Returns all settings, or only the given keys, with the current stateVersion.
methods.name: settings.get

methods.description: Sets one setting. Every key outside the cosmetic allowlist (appearance, ui, editor, shortcuts, locale, notifications.sound, notifications.badges) also needs operator.admin. Side-effecting.
methods.name: settings.set

methods.description: Pages a task's Activity lines (level 1 and 2; level 3 is fetched by ref).
methods.name: tasks.actions

methods.description: Cancels a task; in-flight side effects are recorded as uncertain.
methods.name: tasks.cancel

methods.description: Returns one task with its plan and checklist.
methods.name: tasks.get

methods.description: Lists tasks, most recently updated first.
methods.name: tasks.list

methods.description: Pauses a running task at the next checkpoint.
methods.name: tasks.pause

methods.description: Resumes a paused task.
methods.name: tasks.resume

methods.description: Starts a new attempt of a failed or cancelled task, optionally from a step. Side-effecting: a duplicate would start a second attempt.
methods.name: tasks.retry

methods.description: Archives a thread; running work is not cancelled.
methods.name: threads.archive

methods.description: Creates a thread (default kind main). Side-effecting: a retried key returns the same thread.
methods.name: threads.create

methods.description: Deletes a thread and its messages (receipts and audit entries are kept).
methods.name: threads.delete

methods.description: User-initiated fork: a new side thread with the transcript up to and including messageId. Side-effecting.

methods.description: Returns one thread with its activity counts.
methods.name: threads.get

methods.description: Lists threads, most recent first, each with derived activity counts (running / awaiting input / awaiting approval).
methods.name: threads.list

methods.description: Pins or unpins a thread.
methods.name: threads.pin

methods.description: Sets a user title (titleSource becomes user).
methods.name: threads.rename

methods.description: Restores an archived thread.
methods.name: threads.restore

methods.description: Returns one credential's metadata (never its value).

methods.description: Lists credential metadata (never values).
methods.name: vault.list

methods.description: Asks the desktop to close a pane.

anyOf.description: Where the file landed; quarantined until scanned

attached.description: A CDP debugger session is attached

tree.description: Accessibility snapshot text with ref_N ids (untrusted content)

queued.description: true when the agent was mid-turn and the message was queued

publicKey.description: base64url raw Ed25519 public key (32 bytes)

handshakeSecret.description: Per-launch secret from $PSYCHE_HOME/run/handshake.secret; enables loopback auto-pairing only without an Origin header

signature.description: base64url Ed25519 signature (64 bytes) over connectSigningPayload(...)

type.description: google | microsoft | imap | jmap | stripe_link | mcp | apple:<app> | search:<provider>

scopes.description: Owner-chosen scopes; never taken from the client

code.description: The code shown on the new device; when given it must match the request

events.description: Event names or prefix patterns, e.g. "chat.*"

anyOf.description: Deep link inside the app, e.g. /tasks/<id>

publicKeyFingerprint.description: Device requests: "sha256:" + hex SHA-256 of the raw Ed25519 public key the owner approves

transport.description: Device requests: how the device connected

remoteAddress.description: Device requests: peer address as the Gateway saw it

shortId.description: Client-visible short id for the receipt line

available.description: false → exec reports an error; there is never a host fallback

value.description: Canonical form: origin, absolute path, account id, argv, recipient, bundle id

display.description: Human-readable form for cards and logs

taint.description: Inherited from a tainted creating turn

alsoForget.description: Also stage retraction of memory derived from this thread

query.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the title

paramsRedacted.description: Params with {{cred:…}} placeholders kept; never secrets

level1.description: One-line status shown in the transcript

target.description: Pane-specific target: tab id, workspace path, artifact id

ViewPaneRef.description: Either paneId or pane (the most recent pane of that kind)
